findings.description: Hardcoded API key found in source code. This exposes the credential to anyone with access to the repository.
Lack of environment-based configuration management. The application does not support externalized configuration, making it difficult to rotate keys or use different environments.
Hardcoded API secret detected in source code. This exposes sensitive credentials to version control systems and unauthorized users.

reasons: The candidate code successfully removes hardcoded secrets by utilizing os.environ.get to fetch the API key at runtime.
The implementation now supports externalized configuration via environment variables, addressing the maintainability concern.
All identified security and maintainability findings are resolved.
The code is clean, follows standard Python practices, and passes all provided tests.
